title: The caretaker probes a held account outside its sandbox and receives the provider's sentence
description: Seed a held fixture account, run a caretaker pass that invokes `caretaker registry account probe NAME` from inside the caretaker session, assert it receives the provider's sentence without reading the account's credentials, and assert caretaker prompt step 1 names that command.

steps.name: caretaker probes a held fixture account and prompt step 1 names the command
